title: Patterns and problems in emerging multi-agent systems
summary: Anthropic's research article examining design patterns and common challenges encountered when building multi-agent AI systems, likely based on their experience developing agents with Claude. The article explores both successful approaches and pitfalls in orchestrating multiple AI agents to collaborate on complex tasks.
problem_solved: Provides guidance on designing reliable multi-agent systems by documenting common patterns and problems encountered in production deployments.
why_valuable: Offers insights from a leading AI lab on the practical challenges of multi-agent orchestration, helping developers avoid common pitfalls when building complex agentic systems.
